sentences: Go {£1|one pound} over the higher rate line, and you still keep {58p|fifty eight pence} of it.
People say a pay rise can push you into a higher band and leave you worse off.
But only the money above {£50,270|fifty thousand, two hundred and seventy pounds} is taxed at {40%.|forty per cent.}
Add {2%|two per cent} National Insurance, and you keep {58p|fifty eight pence} of every extra pound.
The real trap starts at {£100,000,|a hundred thousand pounds,} where your tax free allowance starts to disappear.
And if you claim Child Benefit, it's clawed back from {£60,000.|sixty thousand pounds.}
